details:
Finally logged on to android, here are some issues that I've found :

**(1) Unable to go in to Horizontal mode (getting stuck in Potrait mode)**

I tried to Make my phone horizontal, but VRCMobile is still in Portrait mode.

The only moment that VRCMobile is in Horizontal Mode is when the full screen menu shows up

**(2) Need to Introduce the Action : PickupUseDown & Drop**

It is cool that I can pickup pickups but unable to use them, Then I realized that the hand button actually means "PuckupUseDown"

Here we need to introduce PickupUseDown and Drop just like how we are introduced with the Bottom Right Menu button.

**(3) Unable to manipulate Pickups**

On Desktop, we are able to manipulate pickups in our hands by using "UIOJKL" and the scroll wheel.

On Android, **MAYBE** we can have 

- a second Joystick or a set of 6 buttons to control the orientation (equivalent to "UIOJKL")

- a slider to control the distance of the pickup (equivalent to Scroll Wheel)

**(4) Unable to load RealTime Online Images**

On Desktop, Quest2, both are able to load images (there is a time where Lord Momo showed the Online RealTime Loading features (strings and Images))

But on Mobile, Mobile is able to load strings but unable to download images

**(5) Default Camera Distance**

On VRCMobile, when the camera is called out, the distance is too near such that it "cuts" my face, maybe a little further might be good.

(Me as a VRC Citizen, I know that I can switch the anchor to world and then walk away, but to VRC tourists, they might immediately give up the camera)

**(6) Action Menu**

We need the same way of "how the LaunchPad is introduced to the player" for the Action Menu.

We just need to tell the user to hold down the menu button long enough.

(I was thinking how to pull out my circle menu...) 

*These are the issues I've found on Android for now, I hope these issues will be fixed ~*

*OwO/*💗💗💗
title: Android Issues
